# Epic Games
> Epic Games builds and operates game development tools, online services, game publishing platforms, and creator ecosystems.

Epic Games provides Unreal Engine, Epic Online Services, Fortnite creator tools, game publishing resources, developer documentation, and support content across its product ecosystem.

## Unreal Engine
- [Unreal Engine](https://www.unrealengine.com/): Main Unreal Engine product site with engine overview, features, licensing, and ecosystem entry points.
- [Unreal Engine Documentation](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine): Central documentation hub for Unreal Engine installation, workflows, systems, and tools.
- [Unreal Engine API Reference](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/API): API reference for Unreal Engine classes, modules, functions, and programming interfaces.
- [Unreal Engine Blueprints Visual Scripting](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/blueprints-visual-scripting-in-unreal-engine): Guides for building gameplay and tools with Blueprint visual scripting.
- [Unreal Engine Programming with C++](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/programming-with-cplusplus-in-unreal-engine): Documentation for C++ gameplay programming, architecture, and engine integration.
- [Unreal Engine Rendering](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/designing-visuals-rendering-and-graphics-in-unreal-engine): Rendering, graphics, lighting, and visual systems documentation for Unreal Engine.
- [Unreal Engine Learning](https://dev.epicgames.com/community/unreal-engine/learning): Tutorials, courses, and learning resources for Unreal Engine creators.

## Unreal Engine Guides
- [Get Started](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/get-started): Introductory setup and onboarding resources for new Unreal Engine developers.
- [Install Unreal Engine](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/install-unreal-engine): Installation instructions and launcher-based setup for Unreal Engine.
- [Packaging Unreal Engine Projects](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/packaging-your-project): Build, package, and distribute Unreal Engine projects for target platforms.
- [Testing and Optimizing Your Content](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/testing-and-optimizing-your-content): Performance profiling and optimization guidance for Unreal Engine projects.
- [Building Virtual Worlds](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/building-virtual-worlds-in-unreal-engine): Level design, world building, and environment creation workflows.
- [Gameplay Systems](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/gameplay-systems-in-unreal-engine): Core gameplay framework, actors, input, animation, and systems documentation.

## Epic Online Services
- [Epic Online Services](https://dev.epicgames.com/en-US/services): Product overview for Epic Online Services features, services, and developer offerings.
- [Epic Online Services Documentation](https://dev.epicgames.com/docs/epic-online-services): Documentation hub for integrating Epic Online Services into games and applications.
- [Epic Online Services API Reference](https://dev.epicgames.com/docs/api-ref): API reference for Epic Online Services interfaces, operations, and integration details.
- [Epic Account Services](https://dev.epicgames.com/en-US/services-account): Overview of account, authentication, and identity services for developers.
- [Epic Online Services SDK Download](https://dev.epicgames.com/en-US/sdk): SDK access point for Epic Online Services integration packages and tools.
- [Developer Portal](https://dev.epicgames.com/portal/): Portal for managing products, services, credentials, and Epic developer configurations.

## Fortnite Creator
- [Fortnite Creator Portal](https://create.fortnite.com/): Main portal for publishing, managing, and analyzing Fortnite creator experiences.
- [Fortnite Documentation](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/fortnite): Documentation hub for Fortnite creation tools, workflows, and publishing.
- [Unreal Editor for Fortnite](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/fortnite/unreal-editor-for-fortnite-documentation): Documentation for building Fortnite experiences with Unreal Editor for Fortnite.
- [Verse Language Reference](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/fortnite/verse-language-reference): Reference documentation for Verse language syntax, semantics, and programming concepts.
- [Fortnite Creative](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/fortnite/fortnite-creative-documentation): Guides for island creation, devices, gameplay setup, and creator workflows.
- [Publishing Projects in Fortnite](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/fortnite/publishing-projects-in-unreal-editor-for-fortnite): Instructions for publishing and releasing Fortnite creator projects.
- [Island Moderation and Guidelines](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/fortnite/island-moderation-and-guidelines-in-fortnite-creative): Moderation rules and publishing guidelines for Fortnite islands.

## MetaHuman
- [MetaHuman](https://www.metahuman.com/): MetaHuman product site for creating high-fidelity digital humans for real-time projects.
- [MetaHuman Documentation](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/metahuman): Documentation for MetaHuman creation, animation, and pipeline integration.
- [MetaHuman Creator](https://www.metahuman.com/en-US/creator): Browser-based tool for authoring and customizing MetaHuman characters.
- [MetaHuman Animator](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/metahuman/metahuman-animator): Documentation for generating facial animation performances with MetaHuman Animator.
- [MetaHuman for Unreal Engine](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/metahuman/metahumans-in-unreal-engine): Guides for using MetaHumans inside Unreal Engine projects.

## Twinmotion
- [Twinmotion](https://www.twinmotion.com/): Real-time visualization tool for architecture, product design, and immersive presentations.
- [Twinmotion Documentation](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/twinmotion): Documentation for Twinmotion workflows, features, and project creation.
- [Twinmotion Release Notes](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/twinmotion/release-notes-for-twinmotion): Release notes and version changes for Twinmotion updates.
- [Getting Started with Twinmotion](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/twinmotion/getting-started-with-twinmotion): Introductory setup and onboarding guides for Twinmotion users.

## RealityScan and RealityCapture
- [RealityScan](https://www.realityscan.com/): Mobile photogrammetry product for capturing real-world objects into 3D assets.
- [RealityCapture](https://www.capturingreality.com/): Professional photogrammetry software for reconstructing detailed 3D scenes and objects.
- [RealityScan Documentation](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/realityscan-mobile): Documentation for mobile RealityScan capture workflows and usage.
- [RealityCapture Documentation](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/realitycapture): Documentation for RealityCapture processing, reconstruction, and export workflows.

## Developer Community
- [Epic Developer Community](https://dev.epicgames.com/community/): Community hub for tutorials, forums, snippets, and learning resources.
- [Learning Library](https://dev.epicgames.com/community/learning): Tutorials, courses, and educational content across Epic developer products.
- [Forums](https://forums.unrealengine.com/): Community discussion forums for Unreal Engine, Fortnite creators, and Epic tools.
- [Snippets](https://dev.epicgames.com/community/snippets): Community code and content snippets for Unreal Engine and related tools.
- [Events and Livestreams](https://dev.epicgames.com/community/events): Community events, livestreams, and educational sessions from Epic.

## Support and Resources
- [Epic Games Support](https://www.epicgames.com/help/en-US/): Support center for Epic Games accounts, products, and player services.
- [Developer Support](https://dev.epicgames.com/support): Support entry point for Epic developer products and documentation assistance.
- [Unreal Engine Release Notes](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/unreal-engine-release-notes): Release notes for Unreal Engine versions, changes, and fixes.
- [Unreal Engine Samples and Tutorials](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/samples-and-tutorials-for-unreal-engine): Sample projects and tutorials demonstrating Unreal Engine features and workflows.
- [Epic Games Store Publishing Tools](https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/publish): Publishing resources and onboarding for developers releasing games on Epic Games Store.

## Company and News
- [Epic Games Newsroom](https://www.epicgames.com/site/en-US/news): Official news, announcements, and company updates from Epic Games.
- [Epic Games Careers](https://www.epicgames.com/site/en-US/careers): Careers information, open roles, and hiring resources across Epic Games teams.
- [About Epic Games](https://www.epicgames.com/site/en-US/about): Company overview, mission, and information about Epic Games businesses.
- [Safety and Security Center](https://safety.epicgames.com/): Policies, parental controls, account safety, and trust and safety resources.
- [Legal and Policies](https://www.epicgames.com/site/en-US/tos): Terms, legal policies, and user agreement resources for Epic services.
